name: 2D Projection 1D Lookup Particle Cache
definition: A particle cache structure that uses a 2D array of linked lists to store particles, allowing for exact lookup of particles within a spherical radius Rc without returning particles outside that radius, by combining a 2D projection with a 1D search along the z-axis.
summary: This spatial data structure optimizes volume rendering by using a 2D projection and 1D z-axis search to return exactly particles within a spherical radius using integer comparisons.
